names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 12 Μαΐου, «Όσιος Διονύσιος του Ραντονέζ», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε περί το 1570 μ.Χ. στην πόλη Ρζεβ», and its head line reads «Οσιος Διονυσιος Του Ραντονεζ (1570 - 1633)».

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Διονύσιος κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το 1633 μ.Χ. και ενταφιάσθηκε στην Τρόιιτσε - Σεργιέβσκαγια Λαύρα».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). The saint is a Russian one and saint.gr is the source read here; the Russian calendar's own day for him was not looked at.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Διονύσιος του Ραντονέζ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is none of the corpus's many Dionysii**: David Zobninovsky in the world, born at Rzhev about 1570, abbot of the Uspensky house at Staritsa and from 1610 archimandrite of the Troitse-Sergiev Lavra. **`abbot` is in `types`** on the page's «ηγούμενος» and the archimandrite's office that followed; the vocabulary has no word for archimandrite. **Hermogenes is linked** — the page calls him «ο πιο πιστός βοηθός του Επισκόπου Ερμογένους, Πατριάρχου Μόσχας», and the corpus keeps that patriarch, whose Greek page stands on this same 12 May day. **Abraham Palitsyn, Dmitry Pozharsky, Theophanes IV of Jerusalem and the patriarch Philaret have no folders** and are named without links. No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
